label: Diagram 5.2
caption: Diagram 5.2 Type C, side elevation view showing recommended dimensions
description: Diagram 5.2 is a side elevation line drawing of a Type C toilet bay. Against the left rear wall sits a WC with a cistern behind it; a dashed line on the wall above the cistern is labelled 'Position of shelf'. A horizontal bar labelled 'Horizontal grab rail' is drawn above the WC, to the right of the cistern. To the right of the WC is a vertical bar labelled 'Vertical grab rail', with a 'low hook' attached part-way up it and a 'High hook' fixed higher on the wall above it; further to the right, a 'Horizontal closing bar' is fixed to the right-hand wall. Vertical dimensions measured from the floor on the right read 480mm, 680mm, 800mm, 1050mm, 1685mm and 900mm; the vertical grab rail is marked 600mm long. A vertical dimension on the left to the shelf reads 780–800mm. A horizontal dimension along the floor reads 1465mm minimum. Notes on the right read: 1. Refer to Appendix D for appliance and equipment schedule. 2. As long as other dimensions are maintained, the toilet cistern may be concealed. 3. Centre the mid-line axis of the WC on the rear wall.
